method: Complete 0.5-second contact-sheet visual review; additional 0.125-second review of 4866-4870, 4896-4899 and 4905-4915. Assistant-reviewed, not independently verified by a human coach.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Reviewed duration includes ordinary dead balls, substitutions and inbound preparation, not exclusively live-ball time.
split: expansion frozen before any algorithm run on this time range; same game as previous splits, NOT a new-game holdout

shots.note: 黑衣在画面远侧底角接球后跳投，朝右篮出手；以离手及球上行判断，不用延迟比分推断。

reviewedNegatives.note: 黑衣远侧持球摆脱后向内传球，球落低位、球员俯身争球后停表；没有朝篮筐投射弧线。
裁判处理、换人和底线发球准备，普通比赛死球，不是广告或球队长暂停。
白衣推进后分球、运球和手递手，未见出手。
白22突破至左侧近筐后向画面右侧低位队友传球；接球队员收球、转身再传外围，不是一次出手加一次补篮。
白衣外围传球和运球，粗看疑似跳投的动作是传球。
